CHANGES (list ALL modifications, one or multiple):

Change #1: [Category: Loss Function]
- What: Increase the shared uniform negative pool in sampled cross-entropy from 256 to 1,024 items per training batch, retaining the existing target-collision masking. This changes only the negative-pool size in model_design; keep the masked Transformer and its jointly trained item bias unchanged.
- Why: More sampled competitors should expose informative ranking errors more frequently, improving discrimination around the benchmark’s top-10 cutoff.

---

WHY current solution limited:
- Root cause: The 256-item sampled denominator may provide an overly noisy approximation of competition across the full item catalog, leaving insufficient pressure against moderately competitive incorrect items.
- Evidence: The current model achieves macro HR@10=0.58 versus HR@20=0.7013, indicating substantial room to move targets from ranks 11–20 into the top 10; this supports testing stronger ranking supervision but does not establish negative-pool size as the cause.

HOW these changes address it:
- Mechanism: Quadrupling uniform negatives increases the probability of including competitive incorrect items while preserving the sampling distribution and existing objective structure.
- Expected improvement: Predict a modest macro HR@10 increase of approximately 0.005–0.015; treat this as a hypothesis and assess it using the pinned host validation evaluator.
- Synergy (if multiple changes): Not applicable; this is one controlled change, with additional computation confined primarily to the sampled output logits.

KEEP UNCHANGED (must explicitly list):
- Random seed: Preprocessing seed=0 and training seed=42; validation evaluation seed=42.
- Data split: Identical supplied training and validation files; no test-label access or additional data.
- Model: Current MaskedSASRec architecture, dimensions, dropout, query-mask construction, auxiliary masking, tied embeddings, and jointly trained item bias.
- Training: Batch size, optimizer, learning rate, weight decay, epoch limit, early stopping, checkpoint selection, and category time limits.
- Evaluation: Macro-average HR@10 across all four categories, with 200 validation users/category and 99 unique negative candidates under the pinned evaluator.
- Inference: Exactly one independently trained checkpoint per category, unchanged dataset routing and predictor writer, and identical model scoring during validation and held-out inference.
- Environment: DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], artifacts beneath the trial directory, and single-GPU execution.
